title: MZ Hide actor's names in BattleStatus

posts.author: LalaTheGhost
ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Just as a note:
LalaTheGhost said:
ChatGPT says
Click to expand...
It's never a good idea to ask generative AI to code for you. The point of them is to "generate" - to make things up. Between the nonsense code they tend to produce and the fact that they can't reliably solve grade school math, I don't see how it makes sense to consider that a resource.
Case in point: your ChatGPT is telling you to overwrite a function that doesn't exist in that window type.
Also
the section rules
prohibit asking for support with AI-generated code.
Try this: copy into a text editor, save as a *.js file, include as a plugin.
Code:
Window_BattleStatus.prototype.placeActorName = function(actor, x, y) {};

posts.author: LalaTheGhost
posts.body:

posts.body:

No - this request was for RPG Maker MZ. MV draws the names differently. For MV, try:
Code:
Window_BattleStatus.prototype.drawActorName = function(actor, x, y) {};
